column1: # The offsets gate's variant runner over a committed multi-module unit
# reads every row. runOrdinaryVariants is the runner TestOffsetsComposeFromHalvesElixir's
# block-ordinary and cook-ordinary subtests measure through.
# variant   name = a variant, value = the text that replaces the runtime's
# runtime   name = the file each variant replaces and compiles again
# compiled  name = a file of the unit, value = how many times it is compiled
#           over all the variants together: a shared module once, the runtime
#           once per variant (the control: the counter counts, and every
#           variant ran its own runtime). A runner that compiles the whole
#           unit per variant compiles every shared module once per variant.
# answer    name = a variant, key = an ANSWER label probe.exs prints, value =
#           the answer that variant owes; the word is lo = 2, hi = 1
